newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Oil spilled onto frozen Siberian river - official.
newsitem.headline: Oil spilled onto frozen Siberian river - official.

text.p: A break in an oil pipeline has caused a 70-tonne oil spill in Surgut, a Western Siberian centre of Russian oil production, a civil defence official said on Sunday.
The oil spilled onto the frozen Chyornaya River on Friday
but it has not mixed with the water because the river is frozen solid, an official at the local Civil Defence headquarters in Surgut said by telephone.
"There is no reason to be alarmed, it's a common technical breakdown and the consequences are being dealt with successfully," he said.
The oil is no longer spilling out from the pipeline, which is connected to about 250 oil wells, he said.
